text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Sakura Chiyono O—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Look at that! There are so many 
cute plushies!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Sakura Chiyono O 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Lining them up in the room would make it 
so lively and fun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The problem is whether I can get enough to 
line them up... If I work steadily every 
day, maybe in about a year...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Trainer did? To go through all 
that trouble just for me..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"They do say 'good things come to those 
who sleep and wait for the race,' so I'm 
looking forward to it♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
